api.usage: bash publish-sq8-split-panel.sh ROOT MASTER MASTER_SHA DRIVER_SHA
api.master: Absolute canonical regular file, <=65536 bytes, externally SHA-256 pinned; the existing driver owns full input admission.
api.master_sha: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; must match MASTER.
api.freshness: ROOT must exist canonically; ROOT/publication and ROOT/measurement must not exist, including dangling symlinks; MASTER.campaign_dir must equal ROOT/measurement.

publication.archive_members: Entire measurement directory beneath ROOT; no exclusions, truncation, or parsing of result JSONL.
publication.checksum: evidence.sha256; SHA-256 followed by two spaces and evidence.tar.gz
publication.terminal_meaning: Transport publication complete only. Failure evidence may be published with a nonzero original_exit. No scientific acceptance follows from any process exit or publication marker.
publication.failure_behavior: Tar failure, archive >64 MiB, hash failure, or any PUT failure sets publication_exit=95 and prevents a terminal PUT; existing objects are never overwritten.

deadlines.authority: Root provisions and independently verifies the original timer, external deadline, budget, resource limits and compute closure; this wrapper never starts or renews them.

exits.precedence: Preserve any nonzero original driver/setup exit; otherwise publication failure yields 95; otherwise shutdown failure yields 97; otherwise 0.
exits.shutdown: Every installed EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap path requests timeout -k 2 5 shutdown -h +1, even before publication setup. Shutdown output goes directly to SSM so a failed file redirection cannot suppress the request. Uncatchable process/host loss remains covered by root-owned hard stops.
exits.traps: Installed before argument validation; finalization ignores repeated INT/TERM/HUP while bounded publication and shutdown complete.

static_receipt.scope: LOCAL_ONLY_STATIC; no wrapper, function, driver, mock, native, Cargo, rustc, data, network, AWS or scientific execution
static_receipt.command_prefix: rtk proxy systemd-run --user --quiet --wait --pipe --working-directory=/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-split-panel-publication-envelope -p CPUQuota=100% -p AllowedCPUs=0 -p MemoryMax=256M -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p TasksMax=128 -p RuntimeMaxSec=120

checks.command: jq -n --arg original '' --arg sha '' --arg master '' --arg driver '' --arg campaign '' 'empty | (.machine_started_epoch|select(type=="number" and floor==. and .>=1000000000 and .<=9999999999)), (.shared_deadline_epoch|select(type=="number" and floor==. and .>=1000000000 and .<=9999999999)), (length==1 and .[0].campaign_dir==$campaign), {schema:"borsuk-sq8-split-panel-publication-v1",scope:"SCIENTIFIC_DIAGNOSTIC_PANEL",original_exit:$original,archive_sha256:$sha,master_sha256:$master,driver_sha256:$driver,publication_complete:true,compute_closed:false,root_independent_verification_required:true,scientific_result_verified:false,performance_claim:false,quality_claim:false,vendor_win:false}'
git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%an <%ae>%n%B' HEAD && git status --porcelain=v1 && git diff HEAD^ HEAD --check && git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

static_receipt.git_hooks: Disabled for this commit only to honor the prohibition on script execution.

root_handoff.inspect: Authenticate all publication objects and archive members; inspect the driver's LOCAL_ONLY terminal, native reducer decision, full native evidence and owned-unit closure; independently establish compute/volume/timer closure and budget reconciliation.
root_handoff.not_checked: Runtime wrapper behavior, faults, actual uploads, shutdown, native execution, science, or the repository assurance gate. Explicit source-only assignment forbids those executions.
root_handoff.change_scope: One new Bash file only; driver, worker, native code, protocol, assets, resource limits, scientific gates and root worktree unchanged.
